subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept bare `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` as session-naming shortcuts, or should naming stay behind `/name` or an explicit `/new --name`-style syntax?
rationale: The technical field contract now uses the existing `label` path, but the PR intentionally changes user-facing command semantics that overlap the merged `/name` command and the documented `/new [model]` surface.

options.title: Keep Control UI Shortcuts
options.body: Land the Control UI-specific `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` shortcuts on the existing `label` contract with the current docs note.

options.title: Require Explicit Naming Syntax
options.body: Ask the branch to avoid bare `/new <arg>` as a label and use an explicit form such as `/new --name <title>` or `/label` only.

options.title: Defer To Broader Command Work
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve named-new plus cross-channel command grammar through the broader open command PR.

recommendation.title: Keep Control UI Shortcuts
recommendation.body: Land the Control UI-specific `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` shortcuts on the existing `label` contract with the current docs note.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the accepted adjacent `/name <title>` command and were directly asked to review this PR's session/command UX choice.
